title: Great Pyramid of Giza
narration: In Giza, Pharaoh Khufu built the Great Pyramid, the only ancient wonder still standing.
visual: Concept illustration: pyramid at dusk with a smaller pyramid behind. The pyramid survives; color, surroundings and landscape are interpretive.

title: Hanging Gardens
narration: Ancient writers described the Hanging Gardens, but scholars still debate where they stood.
visual: Concept illustration: stepped terrace garden with trees and a central water channel. DISPUTED: site (Babylon or Nineveh) and appearance are uncertain.

title: Statue of Zeus at Olympia
narration: At Olympia, the sculptor Phidias made a seated statue of Zeus with gold and ivory.
visual: Concept illustration: seated Zeus on a throne inside the temple, holding a staff. RECONSTRUCTION: the statue is lost; throne and figure are schematic, based on ancient descriptions.

title: Temple of Artemis
narration: At Ephesus, builders used marble for grand temples dedicated to the goddess Artemis.
visual: Concept illustration: marble colonnaded temple on a stepped base. Proportions and ornament are schematic.

title: Mausoleum at Halicarnassus
narration: At Halicarnassus, a towering tomb honored Mausollos, the ruler of Caria.
visual: Concept illustration: tomb with a tall base, colonnade and stepped roof. SIMPLIFIED RECONSTRUCTION: exact form and sculpture placement are reconstructed.

title: Colossus of Rhodes
narration: On Rhodes, a colossal bronze statue honored Helios, the Greek sun god.
visual: Concept illustration: bronze figure standing on land beside the water, not astride the harbor entrance. ILLUSTRATIVE: pose and site are uncertain.

title: Lighthouse of Alexandria
narration: In Alexandria, the Pharos lighthouse helped sailors find their way to the harbor.
visual: Concept illustration: tiered lighthouse with a lit beacon on Pharos island, a sailing boat nearby. ILLUSTRATIVE: the upper tower and beacon shape are uncertain.
